description: One public table's columns (name, type, and any published profile such as null counts, distinct counts or ranges), its immutable version_id, and its capabilities: whether anonymous sampling, keyed querying and Parquet download are enabled, and, when the publisher declared text search, capabilities.search (spec_digest and keyword_columns for query_table's search). Private workspace tables are not available here: use query_run for sealed output evidence and compare it with the approved recipe document already in the conversation. If that document is unavailable, report the limitation; do not invent a schema or publish a dataset to inspect it. Example: {"table_id": "0f2f6bfa-4a63-4f75-9a0b-1a7d9c5b2e10"}. Read this before writing a query_table call: the column names it lists are the only ones the query grammar accepts.
name: get_table_schema
title: Get a public table's schema
